### Props

| Name        | Type      | Required | Default                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `crumbs`    | `union`   |          | `[]`                                         | The trail, root first, current location LAST. Each crumb: `{ label, to?, href?, icon? }` — `label` is the visible (already translated) text, `to` a vue-router target, `href` a plain URL (use one or the other; both are ignored on the last crumb), and `icon` a PascalCase MDI name resolved via the CnIcon registry (register it with `registerIcons()` at boot). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`  |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Breadcrumbs')` | Accessible name of the breadcrumb nav landmark. Defaults to the lib's translation of "Breadcrumbs"; override per surface when a page carries more than one trail.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `rootText`  | `boolean` |          | `false`                                      | Draw the FIRST crumb's label as text. NcBreadcrumbs gives the root crumb a home icon and prints its `label` only as the accessible name, so "All cases" read as a house. Off by default, which keeps the home icon. A first crumb with its own `icon` keeps that icon.                                                                                                |
| `separator` | `string`  |          | `''`                                         | Draw this text between the crumbs (for example `/`) instead of NcBreadcrumbs' chevron. Empty (the default) keeps the chevron. The separator is decoration: it is not read out.                                                                                                                                                                                        |
